resources.description:

SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0



Start with docs/setup.md. Use this collection as an alternative to cURL for API steps. Local STS_* environment keys contain the Token Exchange application settings; retain those key names.

resources.name: 01 - Application Health
resources.description:
Purpose: Confirm this checkout is running.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200. If unavailable check localhost:8000 and the uvicorn terminal.

resources.name: 02 - MCP tools/list through client
resources.description:
Purpose: Discover registered MCP tools through the client/server protocol.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; four tools including the intentional delete negative-test tool. Discovery grants no authority.

resources.name: 03 - MCP tools/call through client
resources.description:
Purpose: Invoke the selected tool with delegated authority.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200 for an allowed matching request; verify business result. Use the token from 05 for the same tool/course/subject.

resources.name: 04 - Introspect Delegated Token as MCP Resource
resources.description:
Purpose: Inspect delegated identity and approved operation before execution.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; active=true; act.sub=agent_id; audience contains course-mcp-server; check scope and authorization_details.

resources.name: 05 - Token Exchange for Selected MCP Tool
resources.description:
Purpose: Exchange a human access token and fresh actor token for the selected tool.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; copy access_token to delegated_access_token. Match tool_name, course_id and logged_in_subject. RAR creator must equal agent_id.

Setup: in the Token Exchange application select All users are entitled to this application for the tutorial. In the agent’s Agent tasks select Act on behalf of a user, associate UC2 Course MCP Agent Token Exchange, and save. See docs/audit.md for list/enrollment audit examples.

resources.name: 06 - Introspect Subject Token and may_act
resources.description:
Purpose: Check the actual subject delegation mapping.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200; active=true; may_act.sub=agent_id for the supplied may_act route. The human own sub stays the human identity. If using Actor Criteria instead, inspect that explicit rule and Skip default actor validation.

resources.name: 07 - Token Exchange for Delete - No Delete Scope
resources.description:
Purpose: Optional negative test: obtain a delete-intent token without the delete scope.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 200 only if policy permits issuance; expected scope excludes course.delete. Copy returned access_token, then run 08. A policy denial at Token Exchange is a different observed stage.

Setup: in the Token Exchange application select All users are entitled to this application for the tutorial. In the agent’s Agent tasks select Act on behalf of a user, associate UC2 Course MCP Agent Token Exchange, and save. See docs/audit.md for list/enrollment audit examples.

resources.name: 08 - Invoke Delete - Expect Scope Denial
resources.description:
Purpose: Prove the resource boundary rejects missing business authority.

Before running: follow docs/setup-and-api-walkthrough.md; configure IDs and credentials in this collection/environment.

Expected / next action: HTTP 403 with denied_stage=scope and reason mentioning course.delete. No data should be deleted with the supplied mapping.
